# Purpose

This sample checks reading comfort, ordinary prose, lists, references and tables. It contains the identifier ACME-42, an exact amount of 1,234.50 USD, and the date 2026-09-21. Changing the layout must not rewrite any of these values.

A document should accommodate its content. Its page count follows readable text and sensible pagination. A brief section may share a page with another section; a longer section may continue across pages. The title of a section should remain with its opening text.

## Working agreement

- Use real paragraph styles rather than manually formatting every line.
- Preserve exact wording and all meaningful values.
- Inspect the final pages after the last change.

## Follow-up

The editable Word document and the PDF share a single source. A verified PDF provides evidence about one rendering; it does not establish identical pagination in every version of Microsoft Word. Keep the source for subsequent edits.
